name: OnScreenKeyboardProvider
description:
Links an on-screen keyboard to the inputs inside its KeyboardTargets, without changing
those inputs' components: any input, textarea or contenteditable element, including
the library's fields. One keyboard serves them all, shown as a drawer or a popover.

With `show="focus"` focusing a linked input opens the keyboard for it; focusing another
linked input moves the keyboard to it without closing; focus on the keyboard keeps it
open; and focus leaving both closes it, one frame later so a move between inputs does
not flicker. Tapping the focused input again reopens it after the hide key. Closing never
moves focus. Disabled and read-only inputs are not served.

`replaceNative` keeps the device's own keyboard closed while an input is served (see
the prop). `useOnScreenKeyboard()` opens and closes it from code; KeyboardToggle is the
button for it.
signature: ({ show, presentation, replaceNative, layout, enterKind, onOpenChange, container, scrollRoot, glass, side, align, arrow, children, ...keyboard }: OnScreenKeyboardProviderProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: align
props.description: Popover only: alignment with the input. Default "center".

props.name: arrow
props.description: Popover only: draw an arrow. Default false.

props.name: captureTyping
props.description: Physical keys typed while focus is on the keyboard edit the text or target. Default true.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: container
props.description: Drawer only: dock to this element instead of the viewport. See KeyboardDrawer `container`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Every key is disabled.

props.name: enterKind
props.description: The Enter key's label and colour. Default: the target's `enterkeyhint`, else "enter".

props.name: glass
props.description: The drawer's or popup's own material level. Default: the page's.

props.name: layout
props.description:
The layout for inputs whose KeyboardTarget sets none and whose `inputmode` or `type`
asks for none (number pads for numeric, decimal and tel; email; url). Default: the
first of `layouts`, else the locale's layout.

props.name: layouts
props.description: The layouts the globe key cycles through. Omit, or give one, for no globe key.

props.name: locale
props.description: Overrides the locale for the default layout, `decimal` and `alphabet`.

props.name: onEnter
props.description:
Called when Enter is pressed. Unless prevented, an input target gets an Enter keydown
and then its form is submitted (requestSubmit); a textarea or contenteditable target
gets a new line.

props.name: onKeyPress
props.description: Called for every press, before the keyboard acts; `details.preventDefault()` skips the action.

props.name: onLayoutChange
props.description: Called with the layout the globe key moved to.

props.name: onNavigateOut
props.description: Called when an arrow key is pressed at the keyboard's edge, with the screen direction: move focus to the results beside it.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.type: ((open: boolean, details: KeyboardOpenChangeDetails & { target: HTMLElement | null; }) => void) | undefined
props.description: Called with the next open state, why, and the input it serves.

props.name: presentation
props.description: `drawer` (default): KeyboardDrawer at the bottom edge. `popover`: KeyboardPopover anchored to the input.

props.name: replaceNative
props.description:
Keep the device's own keyboard closed while the on-screen keyboard serves an input, by
setting `inputmode="none"` on it and restoring its own value afterwards. `touch`
(default): only where the primary pointer is coarse; `always`; `never`.

props.name: scrollRoot
props.description: Drawer only: the element that receives `--keyboard-inset-height`. See KeyboardDrawer `scrollRoot`.

props.name: show
props.description:
`focus`: the keyboard opens when a linked input gains focus and closes when focus leaves
both the input and the keyboard (kiosks, TVs). `manual` (default): only
`useOnScreenKeyboard().open()` and KeyboardToggle open it.

props.name: showAlternates
props.description: Press and hold (500 ms, or a held Enter) offers accented alternates. Default true.

props.name: side
props.description: Popover only: the preferred side of the input. Default "bottom".

props.name: size
props.description: Key size: sm for narrow panels, md (default) about a control's height, lg for TVs viewed from across a room.

props.name: variant
props.description: keys: separate keycaps (the default for typing layouts); grid: flat tiles (the default for grid layouts: the alphabet, number pads).

props.name: wrap
props.description: Arrow keys continue from the far side at an edge, instead of calling `onNavigateOut`. Default false.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
